lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! Are you finding your way from the station?

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. Yes, I am discovering Paris on foot.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Follow the canal for a quieter start. The city changes pace beside the water.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: That sounds better than rushing straight to the famous view.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: There is time for the market, a café, and the river before evening.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Merci, Camille. I will let the streets lead me there.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! You look ready for a long walk.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. I am, once I choose the right street.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Start toward the canal. The pavements become calmer after the station streets.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Perfect. A calm beginning will help me find my rhythm.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! The canal suits your walking pace today.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. It is difficult to hurry beside this water.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Pause halfway across the footbridge. The view opens from the middle.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: I will. A short pause still counts as exploring.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! Have you seen the fruit stall around the corner?

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. Not yet, but I can smell something sweet.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The peaches are good today. Look before the afternoon crowd arrives.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Then my timing is lucky. Merci for the tip.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! Are you stopping for coffee or only passing through?

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. Coffee, if I can enjoy it without rushing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Stand at the counter for a quick cup, or take a table when you want a longer pause.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: A quick cup today. The street is asking me to keep walking.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! Did the café persuade you to stay?

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. Nearly, but I still want to reach the river.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Keep walking toward the brighter sky between the buildings. The river will appear soon.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: That is a direction I can remember. Merci.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! The river has given you a little more sky.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. I noticed that before I noticed the tower.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The green bookstalls along the quay reward a slow look as well.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Then I will divide my attention between books and the view.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! Those steps are easier if you do not race them.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. I was hoping they would reward patience.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Turn around once you are higher. Paris keeps widening behind you.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Good advice. The climb should include the view it creates.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! You found one of the calmest corners of the square.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. The arcades make the whole place feel sheltered.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Walk beneath them, then come back through the garden. The two routes feel completely different.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: I like a square that offers a second version of itself.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! Have you tried the path beneath the trees?

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. Not yet; I was following the red-brick arcade.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Cross the garden on your next turn. The centre feels quieter than the street outside.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: I will take the quieter route before moving on.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! The green chairs are an invitation, you know.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. My feet understood the invitation immediately.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Choose one facing the path. Resting here is also a way of watching Paris pass.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: One quiet minute, then I will join the path again.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! The bridge is making you look in every direction.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. There is too much detail for one glance.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Look up at the lamps, then down the river. The grand view is built from small things.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Then I will give the bridge the time it is asking for.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! Are you following the river or looking for the bookshops?

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. I was following the river, but books could change the route.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Turn into Saint-Germain when the streets narrow. The shop windows will slow you down.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: That sounds like a worthwhile delay. Merci.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bonjour! Did a bookshop window finally stop you?

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: Bonjour. Only for a moment, but it was a convincing window.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Browse without a plan. The smallest shelves often hold the best surprise.

lines.speaker: traveler
lines.text: I can make room for one surprise before the route begins again.
